segments.an4.197:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.an4.197:1.2: Atha kho mallikā devī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho mallikā devī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an4.197:2.1: “Ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena midhekacco mātugāmo dubbaṇṇā ca hoti durūpā supāpikā [syā. pī. potthakesu “dubbaṇo ca hoti durūpo supāpako”ti evamādinā pulliṅgikavasena dissati] dassanāya;
segments.an4.197:2.2: daliddā ca hoti appassakā appabhogā appesakkhā ca?
segments.an4.197:3.1: “Ko pana, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena midhekacco mātugāmo dubbaṇṇā ca hoti durūpā supāpikā dassanāya;
segments.an4.197:3.2: aḍḍhā ca hoti mahaddhanā mahābhogā mahesakkhā ca?
segments.an4.197:4.1: “Ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena midhekacco mātugāmo abhirūpā ca hoti dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā;
segments.an4.197:4.2: daliddā ca hoti appassakā appabhogā appesakkhā ca?

segments.an4.197:6.1: “Idha, mallike, ekacco mātugāmo kodhanā hoti upāyāsabahulā.
segments.an4.197:6.2: Appampi vuttā samānā abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti.
segments.an4.197:6.3: Sā [so (syā.)] na dātā hoti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ.
segments.an4.197:6.6: Sā ce tato cutā itthattaṃ āgacchati, sā [so (syā.)] yattha yattha paccājāyati dubbaṇṇā ca hoti durūpā supāpikā dassanāya;
segments.an4.197:6.7: daliddā ca hoti appassakā appabhogā appesakkhā ca.

segments.an4.197:10.1: “Ayaṃ kho, mallike, hetu ayaṃ paccayo, yena midhekacco mātugāmo dubbaṇṇā ca hoti durūpā supāpikā dassanāya;
segments.an4.197:10.2: daliddā ca hoti appassakā appabhogā appesakkhā ca.

segments.an4.197:11.1: Evaṃ vutte mallikā devī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an4.197:11.2: “yā nūnāhaṃ [sā nūnāhaṃ (syā.), yaṃ nūnāhaṃ (ka.)] bhante, aññaṃ jātiṃ [aññāya jātiyā (syā.)] kodhanā ahosiṃ upāyāsabahulā, appampi vuttā samānā abhisajjiṃ kuppiṃ byāpajjiṃ patitthīyiṃ kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātvākāsiṃ, sāhaṃ, bhante, etarahi dubbaṇṇā durūpā supāpikā dassanāya.
segments.an4.197:12.1: “Yā nūnāhaṃ, bhante, aññaṃ jātiṃ dātā ahosiṃ samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ, sāhaṃ, bhante, etarahi aḍḍhā [aḍḍhā ca (sī. pī. ka.)] mahaddhanā mahābhogā.
segments.an4.197:13.1: “Yā nūnāhaṃ, bhante, aññaṃ jātiṃ anissāmanikā ahosiṃ, paralābhasakkāragarukāramānanavandanapūjanāsu na issiṃ na upadussiṃ na issaṃ bandhiṃ, sāhaṃ, bhante, etarahi mahesakkhā.
segments.an4.197:13.2: Santi kho pana, bhante, imasmiṃ rājakule khattiyakaññāpi brāhmaṇakaññāpi gahapatikaññāpi, tāsāhaṃ issarādhipaccaṃ kāremi.
segments.an4.197:13.3: Esāhaṃ, bhante, ajjatagge akkodhanā bhavissāmi anupāyāsabahulā, bahumpi vuttā samānā nābhisajjissāmi na kuppissāmi na byāpajjissāmi na patitthīyissāmi, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca na pātukarissāmi;
segments.an4.197:13.5: dassāmi samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ.
segments.an4.197:13.6: Anissāmanikā bhavissāmi, paralābhasakkāragarukāramānanavandanapūjanāsu na ississāmi na upadussissāmi na issaṃ bandhissāmi.
segments.an4.197:13.7: Abhikkantaṃ, bhante … pe … upāsikaṃ maṃ, bhante, bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan”ti.

lines: Sā pana appesakkhatā ādhipateyyasampattiyā parivārasampattiyā ca abhāvena pākaṭā hoti.
Sā panassā issaratā vibhavasampattipaccayā pākaṭā jātāti aḍḍhatāpariyāyabhāvena vadanto “aḍḍhāti issarā”ti āha.
Idha pana vaḷañjanakeneva dhanena mahaddhanataṃ dassento “vaḷañjanakadhanena mahaddhanā”ti āha.
Mahatī īsā mahesā, suppatiṭṭhitamahesatāya pana parehi mahesoti akkhātabbatāya mahesakkhā.
Yasmā pana so mahesakkhābhāvo ādhipateyyaparivārasampattiyā viññāyati, tasmā “mahāparivārā”ti vuttaṃ.
Dassanayuttāti surūpabhāvena passitabbayuttā, dissamānā cakkhūni piyāyatīti aññakiccavikkhepaṃ hitvāpi daṭṭhabbāti vuttaṃ hoti.
Pokkharatāti vuccati sundarabhāvo, vaṇṇassa pokkharatā vaṇṇapokkharatā, tāya vaṇṇasampattiyāti attho.
Tesaṃ matena vaṇṇañca pokkharañca vaṇṇapokkharāni, tesaṃ bhāvo vaṇṇapokkharatā.
Iti paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāyāti uttamaparisuddhena vaṇṇena ceva sarīrasaṇṭhānasampattiyā cāti attho daṭṭhabbo.
Sarīraṃ nāma sannivesavisiṭṭho karacaraṇagīvāsīsādiavayavasamudāyo, so ca saṇṭhānamukhena gayhatīti āha “sarīrasaṇṭhānenā”ti.
Abhisajjatīti kujjhanavaseneva kuṭilakaṇṭako viya tasmiṃ tasmiṃ samuṭṭhāne makaradanto viya lagati.
Yañhi kodhassa uppattiṭṭhānabhūte ārammaṇe upanāhassa paccayabhūtaṃ kujjhanavasena abhisajjanaṃ, taṃ idhādhippetaṃ, na lubbhanavasena.
Kuppatītiādīsu pubbuppatti kopo, tato balavataro byāpādo laddhāsevanatāya cittassa byāpajjanato.
Sātisayaṃ laddhāsevanatāya tato byāpādatopi balavatarā paccatthikabhāvena thāmappatti patitthiyanā.
Chattampi hi vassātapadukkhanivāraṇena maggagamanasādhananti katvā “yānan”ti vuccati.
